thread.title: Please Excuse My Younger Brothers • Uchi no Otouto-domo ga Sumimasen - Episode 14 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters enjoyed the romantic developments and felt the characters were communicating more directly than expected.
Some viewers were enthusiastic about the emotional tension and curious to see how the relationships develop.
The episode’s ending generated excitement and anticipation, but many also found the cliffhanger frustrating because it delays the resolution.
A few commenters were dissatisfied with the focus on the central domestic-romance storyline and preferred more attention on a secondary relationship.
